headline: Avoid the hassle of chartering a yacht! 3 common mistakes to avoid.
primaryText: The #1 Mistake Charterers Do: Inquiring Too Late. Inquire Today With 4.9/5 Rated Company And Get The Best Options For Your Dates. You Will End Up Paying Less For A Better Date. Talk To Us Now
whyItWorks: The ad opens with a list of mistakes to avoid, which promises useful insider advice and makes viewers curious about what the other mistakes are. A real person speaking to camera in a vertical, native-looking video with bold captions feels like friendly advice, not a sales pitch. The 4.9 rating and the promise of lower prices through acting early give a clear reason to inquire now. It has only just started running, so there is no proof of performance yet.
